title: Sheep waving hello
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- fluffy wool body -->
  <circle cx='46' cy='62' r='17' fill='#f5f5ff'/>
  <circle cx='33' cy='58' r='12' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='59' cy='58' r='12' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='40' cy='48' r='12' fill='#fdfdfd'/>
  <circle cx='54' cy='48' r='12' fill='#fdfdfd'/>
  <circle cx='30' cy='68' r='11' fill='#efeffa'/>
  <circle cx='62' cy='68' r='11' fill='#efeffa'/>
  <circle cx='46' cy='72' r='12' fill='#f8f8ff'/>

  <!-- legs -->
  <rect x='35' y='76' width='7' height='15' rx='3' fill='#4a4a5a'/>
  <rect x='52' y='76' width='7' height='15' rx='3' fill='#4a4a5a'/>
  <rect x='33' y='88' width='11' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6a6a80'/>
  <rect x='50' y='88' width='11' height='5' rx='2' fill='#6a6a80'/>

  <!-- ear -->
  <ellipse cx='26' cy='42' rx='7' ry='4.5' fill='#3a3a4a' transform='rotate(-30 26 42)'/>

  <!-- face -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='46' rx='13' ry='14' fill='#3a3a4a'/>
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='42' rx='10' ry='9' fill='#4d4d63'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='25' cy='41' r='2.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='35' cy='41' r='2.6' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='25.5' cy='41.5' r='1.2' fill='#22222e'/>
  <circle cx='35.5' cy='41.5' r='1.2' fill='#22222e'/>
  <!-- nose and smile -->
  <ellipse cx='30' cy='47' rx='3' ry='2.2' fill='#b76a8a'/>
  <path d='M26 51 Q30 54 34 51' stroke='#e0c0d0' stroke-width='1.4' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>

  <!-- waving arm -->
  <rect x='62' y='46' width='6' height='16' rx='3' fill='#3a3a4a' transform='rotate(35 65 54)'/>
  <circle cx='71' cy='43' r='4.5' fill='#4d4d63'/>

  <!-- other arm -->
  <rect x='24' y='62' width='6' height='12' rx='3' fill='#3a3a4a' transform='rotate(-15 27 68)'/>

  <!-- little tail -->
  <circle cx='63' cy='72' r='5' fill='#ffffff'/>
</svg>
